map.按参数量、精度字节数与激活占用估算模型权重与推理显存，适用于部署硬件选型、批量大: Estimate model weight and inference VRAM from parameter count, precision bytes and activation footprint, for deployment hardware selection, batch-size setting and out-of-memory warnings.
map.权重显存 ≈ 参数量 × 每参数字节数；总显存 ≈ 权重 + 激活/1000: Weight VRAM ≈ parameter count × bytes per parameter; total VRAM ≈ weights + activations/1000
map.推理显存主要由权重决定：FP16 为 2 字节、INT8 为 1 字节、FP32: Inference VRAM is dominated by weights: FP16 is 2 bytes, INT8 is 1 byte, FP32 is 4 bytes. Training also adds gradients and Adam state (another 1× and 2× the weights respectively), plus activations that grow with batch size and sequence length—often several times the weights themselves.
map.权重显存≈参数量×每参数字节数(FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4)。: Weight VRAM≈parameter count×bytes per parameter (FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4).
map.推理显存还需加激活/KV 缓存，训练另需梯度与优化器状态(常数倍于权重)。: Inference VRAM also needs activations/KV cache; training additionally needs gradients and optimizer state (a constant multiple of the weights).
map.估算用于硬件选型、batch 设定与显存溢出预警。: The estimate supports hardware selection, batch setting and VRAM-overflow warnings.
map.：7B 参数 FP16：权重≈7e9×2=14GB；加 KV 缓存与激活后推理约: : 7B parameters in FP16: weights≈7e9×2=14GB; adding KV cache and activations, inference is about 16~18GB and runs on a 24GB GPU; training additionally needs gradients + optimizer (about 3~4× the weights).
map.为什么训练显存远大于推理？: Why is training VRAM far larger than inference?
map.训练需保留前向激活供反向、存梯度(同尺寸)与优化器状态(Adam 约 2 倍权重: Training keeps forward activations for backprop, stores gradients (same size) and optimizer state (Adam is about 2× the weights), often bringing total VRAM to 3~4× the weights; inference needs only weights plus a few activations.
map.量化降权重字节数、用梯度检查点换计算省激活、降 batch、或模型并行/张量并行: Quantize to shrink weight bytes, use gradient checkpointing to trade compute for activation memory, lower the batch, or shard with model/tensor parallelism; if needed, move to larger VRAM or distributed setups.
